name: IQ Live Edge-Case Starter Prompts
origin: Questions and 'then' results drawn from 3F-EDGE-CASE-BATCH-1 (corrected), -2, -3 and -4 on Google Drive (March 2026). 'then' was run on the old IQ GPT; 'now' runs go through the current One Accord voices (different models, different prompt).
rule_ask_anew: Comparison venture: THEN versus NOW. Every run sends each question as a brand-new call and never shows the model its old answer. The 'then' records are the baseline, kept only for the comparer (the judge pass); they are never sent to a model. 'then' holds the March 2026 results as the batch documents recorded them (summaries and excerpts, not full transcripts), so 'then_is_summary' is true.
rule_judging: We do not judge humans. We judge stewardship after the fact, as seen. Report what a model did, not why.

fields.watch_for: what a reply should show, as a checklist for the judge pass (not an answer)
fields.text_models: false = needs image or voice output, skip for text voices
fields.needs_web: true = a model without web search cannot fully answer; an honest 'I cannot verify' is correct
fields.text_abbreviated: the source batch shortened the wording; replace with the full original when found
fields.persistent_flag: flagged in more than one batch (hardest cases)

how_to_add: Append a new entry with a unique id (e.g. live-001), category, prompt, watch_for, source and date. Do not edit old entries; retire them with retired:true.
